# WASiM v2 model authoring guide

_Generated by `tools/gen_authoring_guide.py` — do not edit by hand. This is the schema
context for LLM-assisted authoring (WASIM_AUTHORING_ENVIRONMENT_SPEC.md §17.2)._

A model is JSON: `{ wasim_version, simulation_settings, elements: [...] }`.
`simulation_settings`: `{ duration:{value,unit}, timestep:{value,unit}, n_realizations, seed }`.
Every element has `id`, `name`, and a `primitive` (node | stock | event | gate | link | cell | species | medium | resource).
A `node` also carries a `value_rule`. Behavior is determined by which fields are present (traits), not a fixed type taxonomy.
A `Quantity` is `{value, unit}` (unit `"1"` = dimensionless).

## Expression AST (engine-native)

Expressions are an AST, NOT a string. A `value_rule: expression` node carries
`{ expression: { ast: <node> }, inputs: [referenced element ids] }`. AST node ops:

- `literal` — `{op:'literal', value:N, unit?:'…'}`
- `ref` — `{op:'ref', element_id:'other_id'}` — the field is `element_id`, NOT `reference`
- `time_ref` — `{op:'time_ref', property:'elapsed'}`
- `add / subtract / multiply / divide / power` — `{op, left, right}`
- `lt / gt / lte / gte / eq / neq / and / or` — `{op, left, right}`
- `neg / not` — `{op, operand}`
- `call` — `{op:'call', fn:'min', args:[…]}` — the function-name field is `fn`, NOT `function`
- `if` — `{op:'if', cond, then, else}`
- `lookup_call` — `{op:'lookup_call', element_id:'table_id', input, input2?}`
- `array` — `{op:'array', elements:[…]}`

## Constructs

### Inputs
- **Constant** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `fixed` (structured). A fixed, editable scalar value.
- **Stochastic** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `sample` (structured). A random draw from a distribution, resampled per realization.
- **Time Series** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `series` (structured). A tabulated signal over time, interpolated between points.
- **Lookup Table** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `lookup` (structured). A y = f(x) table, interpolated — maps one signal through a curve.

### Functions
- **Expression** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `expression` (structured). A formula over other elements, evaluated each step.
- **Logic Gate** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `gate` (structured). Boolean AND / OR / at-least-k over referenced elements' states.
- **Smoothing / Filter** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `filter` (raw). A rolling-window statistic (mean / min / max / sum / EMA) of an input.
- **PID Controller** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `pid` (raw). A proportional-integral-derivative controller driving an input toward a setpoint.
- **Terminal Value** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `terminal_expression` (raw). A value evaluated once at the end of the run (a terminal reduction).

### Accumulation & delay
- **Stock / Reservoir** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `stock` (structured). Accumulates its inflows minus outflows each step (an integrator).
- **Previous Value (delay)** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `lag` (structured). The value of an input one step ago (a unit delay).
- **Convolution** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `convolution` (raw). Convolves an input with an impulse-response kernel (a distributed delay).
- **Queue** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `queue` (raw). A material delay: an input emerges after a transit time (conveyor / FIFO).

### Events & switches
- **Failure / Event** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `event` (structured). A state machine that fires on a condition or schedule (0 = operating, 1 = failed).
- **Status (latch)** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `status` (raw). A latch flipped on/off by set and reset triggers.
- **Milestone** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `milestone` (raw). Fires once when its trigger condition first becomes true.
- **Hysteresis** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `hysteresis` (raw). A Schmitt trigger: switches between two outputs at high / low thresholds.

### Stochastic processes
- **Stochastic Process (GBM/OU)** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `process` (raw). A geometric-Brownian / mean-reverting continuous process.
- **Markov Chain** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `markov` (raw). A discrete-state chain with a transition matrix and per-state outputs.

### Resources & transport
- **Resource** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `resource` (raw). A finite pool consumed and replenished by links.
- **Cell** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `cell` (raw). A well-mixed compartment holding species in media.
- **Species** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `species` (raw). A transported species, optionally decaying into daughters.
- **Medium** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `medium` (raw). A phase (solid / fluid / gas) that species partition into.
- **Link (transfer)** → `primitive`/`value_rule` = `link` (raw). A transfer of mass between cells or resources.

## Required fields per construct

The v2 parser rejects a model missing these. Fields not listed are optional.

- **stock**: `initial_value` (Quantity). Optional: `inflows`/`outflows` (arrays of flow element ids), `rate` (net-rate — mutually exclusive with flows), `capacity`, `floor`, `return_rate`.
- **node/fixed (Constant)**: `value` (Quantity) OR `values` (number array). Optional: `editable`, `bounds:{min,max}`, `unit`.
- **node/sample (Stochastic)**: `distribution` (see the distribution catalog). Optional: `resampling`, `autocorrelation`, `correlations`.
- **node/expression**: `expression:{ast}`. Optional: `inputs:[ids]` — set to the referenced element ids.
- **node/lookup**: `table:{x:[...], y:[...]}`. Optional: `interpolation`.
- **node/series (Time Series)**: `timestamps:[...]` AND `values:[...]`. Optional: `time_unit`, `interpolation`.
- **node/lag (Previous Value)**: none. Optional: `input:'id'`, `initial:{value,unit}`.
- **node/filter**: `statistic` (mean|min|max|sum|ema). Optional: `input:'id'`, `window` (0 = expanding).
- **node/pid**: `input:'id'` AND `setpoint` (Quantity). Optional: `kp`, `ki`, `kd`, `output_min`, `output_max`.
- **event**: none strictly; a repairable-component event sets `failure_process` (see its sub-schema below). Optional: `trigger`, `effects:[{target, change, mode}]`, `event_value`, `count_limit`, `rate`.
- **gate**: `root` (op-tagged gate tree: and|or|not|n_vote|reference|condition|input). Optional: `semantics` (success|failure, default success).

### `failure_process` sub-schema (repairable-component events)

`{ "basis": <basis>, "time_to_failure": <distribution>, "repair": { "policy": <policy>, "time_to_repair": <distribution> } }`.
- `basis` (required): `exposure_time` | `operating_time` | `demand` | `capacity_demand` | `event` | `condition`.
- `time_to_failure`: a distribution object (same shape as the distribution catalog below), e.g. exponential with `mean` = MTTF.
- `repair.policy`: `repair` | `replace` | `preventive_maintenance` | `none` (default). `repair.time_to_repair`: a distribution (MTTR).

## Distribution catalog (the `distribution` field of a `node/sample`)

Shape: `{ "family": <name>, "parameters": { <param>: <Quantity>, … }, "truncation":{min,max}? }`.
Each parameter is a `{value, unit}` Quantity unless noted. Families and their parameters:

- `uniform` — min, max
- `normal` — mean, stddev
- `lognormal` — mean, stddev
- `lognormal_moments` — mean, stddev (moments of the values, not the logs)
- `triangular` — min, mode, max
- `trapezoidal` — min, lower, upper, max
- `pert` — min, mode, max
- `exponential` — mean
- `gamma` — shape, scale
- `beta` — alpha, beta (optional min, max to rescale)
- `weibull` — shape, scale
- `pareto` — scale, shape (optional location)
- `extreme_value` — location, scale
- `student_t` — degrees_of_freedom (optional location, scale)
- `pearson_iii` — mean, stddev, skewness
- `discrete_uniform` — min, max — PLAIN INTEGERS, not Quantities
- `bernoulli` — prob — a plain Quantity in 0..1
- `binomial` — n, prob
- `negative_binomial` — r, prob
- `poisson` — lambda
- `discrete` — outcomes:[numbers], probabilities:[numbers]
- `sampled` — samples:[numbers] (optional weights:[numbers])
- `log_uniform` — min, max
- `log_triangular` — min, mode, max
- `triangular1090` — p10, mode, p90
- `cumulative` — points:[{x, cumulative_probability}]

Example: `{"id":"ret","name":"Return","primitive":"node","value_rule":"sample","distribution":{"family":"normal","parameters":{"mean":{"value":0.06,"unit":"1"},"stddev":{"value":0.1,"unit":"1"}}}}`

## Expression functions (`{op:'call', fn:NAME, args:[…]}`)

- `min` — The smaller of two values. e.g. `min(a, b)`
- `max` — The larger of two values. e.g. `max(a, b)`
- `abs` — Absolute value (magnitude, sign discarded). e.g. `abs(x)`
- `sqrt` — Square root. e.g. `sqrt(x)`
- `exp` — e raised to the power x. e.g. `exp(-decay * t)`
- `ln` — Natural logarithm (base e). e.g. `ln(x)`
- `log` — Base-10 logarithm. e.g. `log(x)`
- `log2` — Base-2 logarithm. e.g. `log2(x)`
- `floor` — Round down to the nearest integer. e.g. `floor(x)`
- `ceil` — Round up to the nearest integer. e.g. `ceil(x)`
- `round` — Round to the nearest integer. e.g. `round(x)`
- `mod` — Remainder of a divided by b (a modulo b). e.g. `mod(step, 12)`
- `sign` — -1, 0, or 1 by the sign of x. e.g. `sign(x)`
- `int` — Truncate toward zero (drop the fractional part). e.g. `int(x)`
- `step` — Unit step: 1 when x ≥ 0, else 0. e.g. `step(t - onset)`
- `gamma` — The gamma function Γ(x). e.g. `gamma(x)`
- `erf` — The error function. e.g. `erf(x)`
- `erfc` — The complementary error function, 1 − erf(x). e.g. `erfc(x)`
- `sin` — Sine (radians). e.g. `sin(x)`
- `cos` — Cosine (radians). e.g. `cos(x)`
- `tan` — Tangent (radians). e.g. `tan(x)`
- `asin` — Arcsine, in radians. e.g. `asin(x)`
- `acos` — Arccosine, in radians. e.g. `acos(x)`
- `atan` — Arctangent, in radians. e.g. `atan(x)`
- `atan2` — Angle of the point (x, y) from the positive x-axis, in radians. e.g. `atan2(y, x)`
- `sinh` — Hyperbolic sine. e.g. `sinh(x)`
- `cosh` — Hyperbolic cosine. e.g. `cosh(x)`
- `tanh` — Hyperbolic tangent. e.g. `tanh(x)`
- `get_year` — Calendar year of the given time. e.g. `get_year(t)`
- `get_month` — Calendar month (1–12) of the given time. e.g. `get_month(t)`
- `get_day` — Day of month of the given time. e.g. `get_day(t)`
- `get_hour` — Hour (0–23) of the given time. e.g. `get_hour(t)`
- `get_minute` — Minute (0–59) of the given time. e.g. `get_minute(t)`
- `get_second` — Second (0–59) of the given time. e.g. `get_second(t)`
- `occurs` — 1 on the step an event fires, else 0. e.g. `occurs(failure)`
- `changed` — 1 on the step x differs from its previous value, else 0. e.g. `changed(state)`
- `pv_factor` — Present-value discount factor for a rate over n periods, 1/(1+rate)^n. e.g. `pv_factor(0.05, 10)`
- `annuity_factor` — Present-value factor of a level annuity at a rate over n periods. e.g. `annuity_factor(0.05, 10)`
- `table_min` — Minimum value in a lookup table. e.g. `table_min(curve)`
- `table_max` — Maximum value in a lookup table. e.g. `table_max(curve)`
- `column_count` — Number of columns in a table. e.g. `column_count(matrix)`
- `sum_array` — Sum of an array's elements. e.g. `sum_array(arr)`
- `size_array` — Number of elements in an array. e.g. `size_array(arr)`
- `get_element` — The i-th element of an array (0-based). e.g. `get_element(arr, i)`
- `interp_array` — Linear interpolation of x through the (xs, ys) breakpoints. e.g. `interp_array(xs, ys, x)`
- `mean_array` — Arithmetic mean of an array. e.g. `mean_array(arr)`
- `min_array` — Minimum element of an array. e.g. `min_array(arr)`
- `max_array` — Maximum element of an array. e.g. `max_array(arr)`
- `argmin_array` — Index of the minimum element (0-based). e.g. `argmin_array(arr)`
- `argmax_array` — Index of the maximum element (0-based). e.g. `argmax_array(arr)`
- `dot_product` — Dot product of two equal-length arrays. e.g. `dot_product(a, b)`
- `argmin_where` — Index of the smallest value among members where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `argmin_where(cost, available)`
- `argmax_where` — Index of the largest value among members where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `argmax_where(grade, available)`
- `masked_sum` — Sum of values where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `masked_sum(load, active)`
- `masked_mean` — Mean of values where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `masked_mean(util, active)`
- `masked_min` — Minimum of values where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `masked_min(level, active)`
- `masked_max` — Maximum of values where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `masked_max(level, active)`
- `masked_count` — Number of members where mask ≠ 0. e.g. `masked_count(available)`

## Time references (`{op:'time_ref', property:NAME}`)

- `elapsed` — Time elapsed since the run start (in the model's time unit).
- `timestep` — The simulation step size Δt.
- `year` — Current calendar year.
- `month` — Current calendar month (1–12).
- `day_of_year` — Day of the year (1–366).
- `day_of_month` — Day of the current month.
- `days_in_month` — Number of days in the current month.
- `hour` — Current hour (0–23).
- `minute` — Current minute (0–59).
- `second` — Current second (0–59).
- `start` — The run's start time.
- `elapsed_months` — Whole months elapsed since the run start.
- `elapsed_years` — Whole years elapsed since the run start.
